summary: Residential kerb where cars park; nearest house about 15 m, behind a pool and fence.

drivers.seclusion: Garden, pool and tennis court sit between kerb and houses; nearest house 15 m at the east end.
drivers.access_and_room: Open kerb with parked cars; room for a van.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but 2P Mon-Fri resident-permit signs and no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on the same side
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees across the road shade the north side. Morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: Marmion Parade south kerb, in front of the pool and tennis-court garden
